act: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (48 CFR chapter 2) and Class Deviation 2026-O0041, Revision 1

en.title: DFARS 225.7003-3(b)(2)(i)(D)(1): should the COTS fastener exception also list components, as the statute and clause do?
en.summary: DFARS 225.7003-3(b)(2)(i)(D)(1) treats commercially available off-the-shelf (COTS) fasteners as excepted when they are incorporated into “COTS end items, subsystems, or assemblies”. Clause 252.225-7009(c)(2)(i)(D)(1) and 10 U.S.C. 4863(h)(2)(D)(i) also list components. For example, a separate subcontract supplies COTS fasteners containing specialty metal for a COTS component that will enter a non-COTS end item. One reading applies the narrower list in Part 225 to that acquisition. The other reads Part 225 in line with the statute and the clause.
en.impact: No contract with a different result under the two texts has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether Part 225 should also list components, as the statute and clause already do.
